thread:
sachin: FYI planning a coordinated base-image rebuild this weekend to pick up patches for the CVE in musl/alpine. Will include RBAC changes for the image-signer role and a KMS-backed signing flow. Low-impact window: Sat 02:00–04:00 UTC. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on timing, but we need an explicit audit path for who triggered each sign and deploy. Compliance will want immutable logs.

jake: For infra, we need to know whether signing uses our existing KMS key or a new rotation key. If new, we must update key ACLs and k8s Secrets sync. @sachin can you confirm key ARN/URI?

sachin: We'll use the existing customer-managed KMS path: kms://redwood-prod/keys/image-signer. Plan is to rotate to a new key after the rebuild, but not during the window.

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled job created: rebuild-base-images-3517772468 -> staging canary -> prod canary -> prod roll. ETA: Sat 02:00 UTC. Trigger: manual canary approval.

elaine: Two callouts: 1) sidecar images for observability need the same rebuild otherwise CI will fail; 2) devx needs the new base-tag format so starters don't break.

maria: Also RBAC change: we're tightening who can sign images. New group = image-signer, perms = kms:Sign, storage:PutObject (signed-manifests), iam:PassRole blocked. Need list of members before we cut.

kevin: Rollback plan: keep previous signed image in GCR with a label older-signed-<sha>. Canary monitored by latency/500/trace error spikes for 30m. If spike -> revert traffic and re-sign previous tag. Who has authority to revert?

sachin: Revert authority = oncall-eng-sre + security-approver. I'll add both to the image-signer ACL for emergency only (just for the window).

security-bot: checklist: [x] SBOM generated for each image, [x] cosign attestations, [ ] immutable audit events to audit-logs S3 (pending). Recommend CloudTrail + KMS key usage logging enabled.

maria: On audit events: we need signed records of: sign command, cosign key ID, signer identity, and deploy job id. Put those into the immutable bucket with object lock. Also wire up an alert if signing key is used outside the window.

jake: Infra: we can emit a publish event from the signing service to audit-logs S3 and also replicate to BigQuery for search. We'll add lifecycle rules after retention policy is finalized. Need ops tickets for object-lock config.

carla: any customer-impact notes? Private deployments using customer KMS might need guidance. Are we planning docs for self-hosted?

sachin: For private installs, we'll publish a separate runbook: how to configure KMS path and RBAC for on-prem signers. Not in this weekend's cut, but we will post a preflight checklist.

elaine: CI flakiness check: please ensure the builder image digest pins remain stable during canary; otherwise build caches blow up. Maybe keep a stable tag alias for 24h post-cut.

kevin: On vuln triage: the CVE was labeled medium but exploitability on our stack is low. Still want to patch quickly. Confirmed patch available in upstream alpine edge; we'll rebuild with glibc variant where possible for critical services.

maria: Also verify that attestation metadata includes the CVE scan baseline and scanner version so we can prove remediation.

sachin: Action items: (1) jake — create KMS ACL change PR and infra tickets (2) maria — provide final image-signer group list (3) kevin — prepare rollback runbook and monitoring rule (4) elaine — update devx starter docs pre-cut (5) carla — draft customer-private-runbook. I'll coordinate the canary approvals.

ops-bot: reminder: runbook template created at https://wiki.internal/rebuilds/base-image-rebuild-template

jake: taking (1). PR will reference infra-1234. Expecting 3 approvals for RBAC change.

maria: I'll DM the group membership list in 1h. Also want to do a quick table-top incident sim after cut.

kevin: Note: if the canary sees a sustained 2x error rate, automation will cut traffic and open incident. Make sure escalation path has security oncall.

sachin: Good call. Adding security-oncall to the automation list.

carla: thanks everyone. If no blockers by EOD we'll ship the schedule and runbook. :thumbsup:
